question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
-- Let me also verify the top few customers to make sure the approach is correct
-- and double-check there aren't any edge cases

-- Full query to get the customer with highest average monthly change
WITH monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', payment_date) as payment_month,
        SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
monthly_with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        payment_month,
        monthly_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_monthly_total
    FROM monthly_payments
),
changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        payment_month,
        monthly_total - prev_monthly_total as monthly_change
    FROM monthly_with_prev
    WHERE prev_monthly_total IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ch.monthly_change), 4) as avg_monthly_change,
    COUNT(*) as num_changes
FROM changes ch
JOIN customer c ON ch.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1
